description: A stiff round brush used to apply hot glue to a spine and work it down between the sections. Spinning it in the pot helps break up glue that has thickened so it spreads freely.
name: glue brush

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1902), Chapter VIII, p.117. Internet Archive.
